title: A checked façade around a trusted core: bounded tenant-isolation failure

environment.language: ISO C17; C11 draft comparisons explicitly bounded
environment.dependencies: Implement mechanisms locally using declared typed storage/callbacks; hosted harness and diagnostic runtimes are separate. See laboratory contract for exact dependencies.

limitations: Exact published C17 text remains an access gap.
Public anchors do not establish all written independent or delayed obligations.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Derive the integer-wrap admission defect, attacker-controlled transition and exact violated authority property; distinguish a checked trusted-core boundary from whole-process memory safety.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Implement the subtraction-based boundary check, unchanged-on-failure behavior and an internal validated descriptor, preserving the simple core while documenting every remaining caller and same-process assumption.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Run the local cross-tenant demonstration with synthetic canaries, compare flawed/repaired outcomes, enumerate all ordinary tenant/offset/count combinations around8 and test UINT_MAX wrap cases. Reject the flawed-check mutant by a normal semantic assertion. Explain why ASan may remain quiet: every actual array access is in bounds. Test mitigation regression without claiming arbitrary code execution or privilege escalation.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Move the descriptor across an FFI or serialized boundary: reject fabricated fields and revalidate at that boundary rather than trusting a C typedef. Delayed assessment separates read from write capabilities and allows a read-only subview; derive authority attenuation and test that subview construction cannot widen rights.
objective_coverage.scope: Authored assessment obligations, not an assertion that a learner has demonstrated them.
